def subtract<w>(a, b):
    x = bits(a, w)
    y = bits(b, w)
    result = [0] * (w + 1)
    borrow = 0
    for i in range(w):
        parity = x[i] ^ y[i]
        result[i] = parity ^ borrow
        borrow = ((1 ^ x[i]) & y[i]) | ((1 ^ parity) & borrow)
    result[w] = borrow
    return pack(result)

x = bits(a, p)
y = bits(b, q)
quotient = [0] * p
remainder = [0] * (q + 1)
for i in range(p - 1, -1, -1):
    remainder = [x[i]] + remainder[:q]
    difference = bits(subtract<q+1>(pack(remainder), b), q + 2)
    take = 1 ^ difference[q + 1]
    for j in range(q + 1):
        remainder[j] = (difference[j] & take) | (remainder[j] & (1 ^ take))
    quotient[i] = take
valid = 0
for i in range(q):
    valid = valid | y[i]
for i in range(p):
    quotient[i] = quotient[i] & valid
for i in range(q):
    remainder[i] = remainder[i] & valid
return pack(quotient), pack(remainder[:q]), valid, 1 ^ valid
